hits.title: Introducing Pulse AI for Institutional Trading Analytics | Hitesh Mittal posted on the topic | LinkedIn
hits.snippet: This week, we announced Pulse AI, the world's first AI-native interface for institutional trading analytics. Pulse AI connects our Pulse Analytics suite to Claude, ChatGPT, and the other AI assistants desks already use, so traders can ask questions in plain language and get answers grounded in BestEx Research's proprietary models and historical market data. It opens a third pathway to our analytics suite, alongside our existing AMS and API access. For the last two decades, pre-trade and post-trade tools have often served as compliance evidence for best execution rather than as a way to improve execution or portfolio construction. Pre-trade models were not robust enough to build a portfolio around, so most PMs who needed one have had to build their own. TCA has become a reporting formality, documenting what happened rather than an analysis that informs what you do next. And most of it still arrives as a spreadsheet. But better cost models can create a more useful pre-trade process, and AI can create a better workflow.
